features.feature: Atomic pipeline builder and typed intermediate execution

rust.surface: Pipeline.run_durable, sealed read kernels and shared StepExecutor; pending batch/prepared effects

python.surface: Pipeline and atomic step_pipeline builders; run_durable with checked arithmetic, ordinary nested loop bodies and all five structural steps and all eight aggregation steps, 35 numeric/topology loop instruction forms, explicit writeback/topology/schema; unoptimized AlgorithmBuilder arithmetic; supported unoptimized AlgorithmBuilder message-pass blocks; checked flow/residual maps and immutable aliases; supported declarative expression/structured-iteration builders with either optimization setting; all four predicate/rank steps; node/edge/reservoir sampling masks; selected edge-weight transformation

features.persistence: Certified memory programs accept one delta; supported durable programs journal one acceptance, including explicitly attached computed columns. Read-only computations/outputs create no history.
features.limits: Certified memory execution and supported durable programs share sealed native read kernels, one pending operation and one acceptance. Root topology loops, thirteen classic wrappers, all structural/aggregation/filtering steps, supported message blocks and declarative expressions, flow/residual/alias values, sampling masks, shared arithmetic/normalization and 35 loop instruction forms retain their documented domains. Ordinary bodies recursively prepare sealed children; workers make no registry or custom Step/Algorithm callbacks. Maps, columns, graph/table captures and aliases preserve immutable bindings with copy-on-write mutation. Computation alone creates no graph history; explicit attachment stages writeback. Expressions preserve incidence counts versus distinct-neighbor values, ordered async visibility and public ExprContext/StepInput/Expr.eval shapes. Predicates retain typed equality, exact mixed comparisons and stable ranks; masks never alter membership. Seeded sampling retains local RNG and selected IDs, rejecting oversized counts while capping reservoir requests. Normalization rejects invalid epsilon, NaN/reversed clip bounds, nonfinite inputs and unrepresentable intermediates; unbounded clip sides remain valid. Remaining: edge-aware registers, normalize(min/mean), unported history/read producers and composition containers, owner-bound subgraph arrays/foreach and custom Rust mapping callbacks, fixed-child/provisional topology domains, remaining expression lowering/alternate plans/public IR, streaming and A14 naming/cache/run-history decisions. Selected adjacency rebuilding/sorting, output allocation and first aliased mutation remain costs. Bounded alias timings do not establish general latency, allocator/RSS or A15 production budgets. Extreme-value normalization requiring scaled intermediates remains outside the current finite f64 contract. Edge-weight scaling shares selected pending reads; omitted factor and legacy unit/nonnumeric behavior remain, while malformed/nonfinite explicit factors and numeric overflow reject.
